work_identified: Thor bu rDo rje phag mo'i zab khrid — a 'thor bu' (miscellaneous) compiled volume from Tshamdrak Monastery (Bhutan), named for its primary text: profound guidance instructions on Vajravārāhī. EAP310 naming patterns confirm 'thor bu' volumes consistently contain multiple discrete sub-texts; Neyphug EAP310-2-2-26 ('Thor bu Zhal gdams dang gnas phug dkar chag') holds 8 individual titles including 'rDo rje phag mo'i zab khrid' as one component, confirming the multi-work container pattern. A separate BDRC record (WA0XL868BB8EB1B3D) catalogs 'rdo rje phag mo'i zab khrid' as a discrete work, and there is a cognate Rinchen Terdzö text 'rdo rje phag mo'i zab khrid yang gsang kun gyi snying po', but neither is confirmed as the Tshamdrak compilation.
